system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: cloud-run-service.jinja

resources:
  - name: api-service-account
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
    properties:
      accountId: cloud-run-api-sa
      displayName: Cloud Run Python API Service Account
      description: Dedicated service account for the Cloud Run Python 3.12 API service

  - name: api-artifact-registry
    type: gcp-types/artifactregistry-v1:projects.locations.repositories
    properties:
      parent: projects/[PROJECT_ID]/locations/us-central1
      repositoryId: python-api-repo
      repository:
        format: DOCKER
        description: Container registry for Python API images
        labels:
          environment: production
          managed-by: deployment-manager

  - name: api-secret-key
    type: gcp-types/secretmanager-v1:projects.secrets
    properties:
      parent: projects/[PROJECT_ID]
      secretId: python-api-secret-key
      secret:
        replication:
          automatic: {}
        labels:
          environment: production
          app: python-api

  - name: secret-accessor-binding
    type: gcp-types/secretmanager-v1:virtual.projects.secrets.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.api-secret-key.name)
      role: roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor
      member: $(ref.api-service-account.email)

  - name: python-api-cloud-run
    type: gcp-types/run-v1:namespaces.services
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - api-service-account
        - api-artifact-registry
        - api-secret-key
    properties:
      parent: namespaces/[PROJECT_ID]
      location: us-central1
      apiVersion: serving.knative.dev/v1
      kind: Service
      metadata:
        name: python-api
        namespace: '[PROJECT_ID]'
        labels:
          environment: production
          app: python-api
          runtime: python-3-12
          managed-by: deployment-manager
        annotations:
          run.googleapis.com/ingress: internal-and-cloud-load-balancing
          run.googleapis.com/ingress-status: internal-and-cloud-load-balancing
          run.googleapis.com/launch-stage: GA
          run.googleapis.com/description: Production Python 3.12 API on Cloud Run
      spec:
        template:
          metadata:
            name: python-api-v1
            labels:
              app: python-api
              version: v1
            annotations:
              autoscaling.knative.dev/minScale: '1'
              autoscaling.knative.dev/maxScale: '20'
              run.googleapis.com/cpu-throttling: 'false'
              run.googleapis.com/startup-cpu-boost: 'true'
              run.googleapis.com/execution-environment: gen2
              run.googleapis.com/sessionAffinity: 'true'
          spec:
            serviceAccountName: $(ref.api-service-account.email)
            containerConcurrency: 80
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            containers:
              - name: python-api
                image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/[PROJECT_ID]/python-api-repo/python-api:latest
                ports:
                  - name: http1
                    containerPort: 8080
                    protocol: TCP
                env:
                  - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
                    value: '1'
                  - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
                    value: '1'
                  - name: PORT
                    value: '8080'
                  - name: ENVIRONMENT
                    value: production
                  - name: LOG_LEVEL
                    value: INFO
                  - name: GCP_PROJECT
                    value: '[PROJECT_ID]'
                  - name: API_SECRET_KEY
                    valueFrom:
                      secretKeyRef:
                        name: python-api-secret-key
                        key: latest
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: '2'
                    memory: 1Gi
                  requests:
                    cpu: '1'
                    memory: 512Mi
                startupProbe:
                  httpGet:
                    path: /health/startup
                    port: 8080
                    httpHeaders:
                      - name: User-Agent
                        value: GoogleHC/1.0
                  initialDelaySeconds: 5
                  timeoutSeconds: 3
                  periodSeconds: 10
                  failureThreshold: 6
                livenessProbe:
                  httpGet:
                    path: /health/live
                    port: 8080
                    httpHeaders:
                      - name: User-Agent
                        value: GoogleHC/1.0
                  initialDelaySeconds: 30
                  timeoutSeconds: 3
                  periodSeconds: 30
                  failureThreshold: 3
                securityContext:
                  runAsNonRoot: true
                  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        traffic:
          - percent: 100
            latestRevision: true

outputs:
  - name: serviceUrl
    value: $(ref.python-api-cloud-run.status.url)
  - name: serviceName
    value: $(ref.python-api-cloud-run.metadata.name)
  - name: serviceAccountEmail
    value: $(ref.api-service-account.email)
  - name: artifactRegistryRepo
    value: $(ref.api-artifact-registry.name)
